_comment: Shared accept/reject fixture for a yt-dlp `--cookies-from-browser` selector, `BROWSER[+KEYRING][:PROFILE][::CONTAINER]`. Asserted from both sides so the two independent validators cannot drift apart: TypeScript normalizeCookiesBrowser (src/constants/cookies-browsers.ts, src/constants/cookies-browsers.test.ts) and Rust normalize_cookies_browser (src-tauri/src/services/yt_dlp/cookies.rs). The frontend composes the selector from the browser combo and the optional profile field and validates it before the round trip; the backend re-validates the value it receives and is what decides whether it reaches a yt-dlp argv. `valid` entries carry the normalized form both sides must produce (browser and keyring lowercased, whitespace around separators dropped, profile and container kept as typed). Add a case to both sides at once by editing this one file.
